mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the small intestine to the meal was most worthwhile: it distinguished digestion from absorption and explained how simple sugars enter blood vessels.

leastWorthwhile.text: Bringing the supply system and guided arm together was predictable because it was the only offered combination, although the result usefully summarized their different roles.

surprise.text: Holding the glass still still requires muscles to pull against its weight and use energy.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless; each followed the stated route from food to the arm. The note about stored fuel was useful but left how it is stored unexplained.

continue.text: I would choose to continue if another chapter explored an equally concrete question. The final explanation made an ordinary action more interesting, though the single-option choices offered little opportunity to make decisions.
